veterinaria:
CREATE TABLE `consultas` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `mascota_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Mascota atendida en la consulta',
  `veterinario_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Veterinario que atendio',
  `fecha` date NOT NULL COMMENT 'Fecha de la consulta',
  `motivo` enum('control','emergencia','cirugia','vacunacion') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Motivo de la consulta',
  `costo` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Costo cobrado por la consulta en quetzales',
  `duracion_min` smallint NOT NULL COMMENT 'Duracion de la consulta en minutos',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `mascota_id` (`mascota_id`),
  KEY `veterinario_id` (`veterinario_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `consultas_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`mascota_id`) REFERENCES `mascotas` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `consultas_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`veterinario_id`) REFERENCES `veterinarios` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=61 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Consultas atendidas en la clinica';

CREATE TABLE `duenos` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(120) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nombre completo del dueno',
  `telefono` varchar(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Telefono de contacto',
  `ciudad` varchar(60) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Ciudad de residencia del dueno',
  `fecha_registro` date NOT NULL COMMENT 'Fecha en que se registro en la clinica',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Duenos de las mascotas atendidas';

CREATE TABLE `especies` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(60) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nombre de la especie, por ejemplo canino',
  `esperanza_vida` tinyint NOT NULL COMMENT 'Esperanza de vida en anios',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Especies que atiende la clinica veterinaria';

CREATE TABLE `mascotas` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(60) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nombre de la mascota',
  `dueno_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Dueno de la mascota',
  `especie_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Especie de la mascota',
  `fecha_nacimiento` date NOT NULL COMMENT 'Fecha de nacimiento de la mascota',
  `peso_kg` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Peso actual en kilogramos',
  `sexo` enum('macho','hembra') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Sexo de la mascota',
  `esterilizado` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '1 si la mascota esta esterilizada',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `dueno_id` (`dueno_id`),
  KEY `especie_id` (`especie_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mascotas_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`dueno_id`) REFERENCES `duenos` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `mascotas_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`especie_id`) REFERENCES `especies` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=61 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Mascotas registradas en la clinica';

CREATE TABLE `tratamientos` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `consulta_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Consulta que origino el tratamiento',
  `descripcion` varchar(200) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Descripcion del tratamiento indicado',
  `dias` tinyint NOT NULL COMMENT 'Duracion del tratamiento en dias',
  `precio` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Precio del tratamiento en quetzales',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `consulta_id` (`consulta_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tratamientos_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`consulta_id`) REFERENCES `consultas` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=301 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Tratamientos indicados en cada consulta';

CREATE TABLE `vacunas` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `consulta_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Consulta en la que se aplico la vacuna',
  `nombre_vacuna` varchar(80) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nombre de la vacuna aplicada',
  `lote` varchar(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Numero de lote de la vacuna',
  `proxima_dosis` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Fecha de la siguiente dosis, NULL si no aplica',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `consulta_id` (`consulta_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `vacunas_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`consulta_id`) REFERENCES `consultas` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=301 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Vacunas aplicadas durante las consultas';

CREATE TABLE `veterinarios` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(120) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nombre completo del veterinario',
  `colegiado` varchar(12) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Numero de colegiado profesional',
  `fecha_ingreso` date NOT NULL COMMENT 'Fecha de ingreso a la clinica',
  `honorario_hora` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Honorario por hora en quetzales',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `colegiado` (`colegiado`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Veterinarios que atienden en la clinica';

CREATE TABLE `booking_services` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `booking_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Booking the service was charged to',
  `service_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Service consumed',
  `quantity` smallint NOT NULL COMMENT 'Units consumed',
  `charged_at` date NOT NULL COMMENT 'Date the service was charged',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `booking_id` (`booking_id`),
  KEY `service_id` (`service_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `booking_services_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`booking_id`) REFERENCES `bookings` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `booking_services_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`service_id`) REFERENCES `services` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=301 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Services charged to each booking';

CREATE TABLE `bookings` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `guest_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Guest who made the booking',
  `room_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Room assigned to the booking',
  `check_in` date NOT NULL COMMENT 'Check-in date',
  `check_out` date DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Check-out date, NULL if the stay is open',
  `nights` smallint NOT NULL COMMENT 'Number of nights booked',
  `total_amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Total charged for the stay in USD',
  `status` enum('confirmed','checked_in','checked_out','cancelled') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Booking status',
  `channel` enum('web','agency','walk_in','phone') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Channel the booking came from',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `guest_id` (`guest_id`),
  KEY `room_id` (`room_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`guest_id`) REFERENCES `guests` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`room_id`) REFERENCES `rooms` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=61 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Room bookings made by guests';

CREATE TABLE `guest_reviews` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `booking_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Booking being reviewed',
  `score` tinyint NOT NULL COMMENT 'Score from 1 to 5',
  `submitted_at` date NOT NULL COMMENT 'Date the review was submitted',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `booking_id` (`booking_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `guest_reviews_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`booking_id`) REFERENCES `bookings` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=301 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Guest reviews left after a stay';

CREATE TABLE `guests` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `full_name` varchar(120) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Guest full name',
  `email` varchar(120) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Guest contact email',
  `country` varchar(60) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Country of origin',
  `loyalty_tier` enum('none','silver','gold','platinum') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' COMMENT 'Loyalty program tier',
  `signup_date` date NOT NULL COMMENT 'Date the guest profile was created',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Guests registered at the hotel';

CREATE TABLE `room_types` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(60) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Room type name, for example double',
  `capacity` tinyint NOT NULL COMMENT 'Maximum number of guests',
  `base_rate` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Base nightly rate in USD',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Room categories offered by the hotel';

CREATE TABLE `rooms` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `room_number` varchar(8) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Room number as shown on the door',
  `type_id` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Room type of this room',
  `floor` tinyint NOT NULL COMMENT 'Floor where the room is located',
  `status` enum('available','occupied','maintenance') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Current room status',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `room_number` (`room_number`),
  KEY `type_id` (`type_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `rooms_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`type_id`) REFERENCES `room_types` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=61 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Physical rooms of the hotel';

CREATE TABLE `services` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(80) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Service name, for example breakfast',
  `price` decimal(8,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Service price in USD',
  `category` enum('food','spa','transport','laundry') NOT NULL COMMENT 'Service category',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Extra services the hotel sells';
